sections.title: What we publish, and how it gets made
sections.content:
• Platform comparisons. Two systems put side by side on cost, architecture, and risk, from hands-on evaluation rather than vendor decks.
  • Trends reports. Where a market is heading, built from interviews with the people running it.
  • Practitioner studies. Questions put to working practitioners, with their answers printed and quoted in their own words.
  • Buyer's guides. A decision framework for a specific purchase, so a team knows what to weigh before they sign.
  • Benchmarks. A scored evaluation of the field against a fixed rubric, so results compare like for like.
  • Category landscapes. A map of a space end to end, showing who does what and where the gaps are.

Original research, done by hand, not a restatement of what is already out there.

items.question: Who writes these?
items.answer: Content Cucumber's writers, the same people who write for our clients. It is human research and human writing from start to finish.

items.question: Do I have to give my email?
items.answer: The reports are gated, so yes for those. The studies are open, and you can read a study page and answer its question without giving anything.

items.question: Can I quote from them?
items.answer: Yes, with attribution to Content Cucumber and a link back. If you want the underlying material for something you are writing, ask and we will talk.

items.question: How often does something new publish?
items.answer: When the work is finished. No calendar, no quota, and nothing gets shipped to fill a slot.
